topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Well, well, well, looks like Mister Wheelman's joyride came to a screeching halt. Car towed from his own driveway, huh? Now, that's what I call a little slice of hard luck, or maybe just the universe handing out what's due. Can’t help but whistle a tune walking up to that spot, empty but for a lonely tire mark. Mister Wheelman probably thought he was slick, parking all improper. Bet he didn't see it coming. But here I am, with the numbers of every tow yard in the city. Might as well stroll on over, whistling, and see what kind of story he's got cooking. Could be a real plum case, if I play my cards right.
